# Peace Beyond

> Peace Beyond offers a calm, shame-free path through masked ADHD burnout for twice-exceptional solo entrepreneurs.

Peace Beyond is taking shape as a practical, shame-free place for 2e ADHD adults rebuilding after quiet burnout.

Peace Beyond offers education and reflection, not diagnosis or crisis care. If you may hurt yourself or cannot stay safe, call or text 988 in the U.S. or contact your local emergency service.

## Join the early list

https://peacebeyond.org/#start

Your information is used only to share Peace Beyond updates. See the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
